parse.text:
If you were looking for a different Jokujo unit, see Delinquent (disambiguation)

Overview

Delinquent (The Universe) is a MythicalMythical. He can only be obtained by evolving Delinquent (Serious).

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: The Universe

Every attack he starts to timestop/freeze enemies (even flying) in his AoE for a few seconds and attacking them after (multi-hit) making him very useful for Fire Enemies when they are sprinting past.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
